headline: Djarum Group Restructures Business Towers, 2 Companies Merged
summary: The Djarum group plans to merge PT Komet Infra Nusantara and PT Darmanusa Tritunggal into Protelindo, effective January 1, 2027. The aim is efficiency and synergies.
why: Protelindo is an Indonesian telecom tower operator, and tower consolidation affects mobile network infrastructure costs. Mergers in this sector change the market structure for tower leasing.
original_headline: Grup Djarum Rombak Bisnis Menara, 2 Perusahaan Dilebur
